observable_features: A blank-faced classical bust, flowers and a low-resolution city image are juxtaposed inside one digitally assembled cover.
A receding black checkerboard and a flat pink field create conflicting spatial layers.
Gray CD-package-like framing, Japanese text and a small green geometric icon connect the collage to consumer-media graphics.
